notes.title: Small Update v1.1
notes.notes:
Here's what's new in this version:

[b]Features:[/b]

    [list]
[*] Added the option to aim with the mouse.
[*]     Toggle between aim and non-aim mode for more control over your gameplay experience.
[/list]

[b]Balancing:[/b]

    [list]
[*] The first 10 waves are now 20% easier, making the game more accessible for newcomers.
[/list]

[b]Minor Updates:[/b]

   [list]
[*]  Improved the FPS counter for better performance tracking.
[*]     Updated the game icon to a fresh new design.
[*]     Renamed the game executable for better organization.
[/list]
